scope: Object shadow_terminator_geometry_offset (shadow-ray origin lift on smooth triangles, static, instanced, moving and deforming) and shadow_terminator_shading_offset (shift_cos_in in BSDF evaluation and sampling, offsets 0 to 3, the wide cosine beyond pi for offsets above 2) under sun and point lights against original CPU images, with native command replays. A NaN shading offset is rejected before dispatch.
